title: Dynamical Low-Rank Compression of Neural Networks with Robustness under Adversarial Attacks

predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: References [49] and [50] are the identical paper (Y. Xu and P. Ghamisi, 'Universal adversarial examples in remote sensing: Methodology and benchmark', 2022), differing only in journal spelling ('IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing' vs 'IEEE Trans. Geosci. Remote Sens.'). Both entries are cited in the text: [49] at the Mixup-attack definition (Section B.1.4) and [50] at the attack-implementation note (Section B.1). One paper therefore appears twice in the bibliography.

predicted_errors.error_location: Proposition 2 statement (Section 4) vs Appendix C proof
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: The statement claims κ(S) ≤ exp(R(S)/(2σ_r(S))) + c, but the proof derives ln κ(S) ≤ R(S)/(√2 σ_r(S)²) (eq 35) and closes with 'which, after exponentiation, yields (4)'. The two exponents differ in the constant (1/2 vs 1/√2) and in the power of σ_r (σ_r vs σ_r²); the '+c' term appears only in the statement and is never derived. Scale analysis confirms the inconsistency: under S → cS the regularizer scales as R → c²R and σ_r → cσ_r, so the statement's exponent R/(2σ_r) scales linearly in c while κ is scale-invariant; the proof's R/(√2σ_r²) is scale-invariant, matching κ. The proof chain (31)→(35) is internally consistent, so the erroneous element is the printed Proposition 2 statement.

predicted_errors.error_location: Table 2 vs Appendix figures (UCM VGG16 clean accuracy)
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: Table 2 reports VGG16/UCM Baseline clean accuracy 94.40±0.72 and RobustDLRT clean 94.61±0.35. The appendix sweeps for the same model/dataset give Full-Rank clean 92.40 (Fig 4), 94.42 (Fig 5), and 93.82 (Fig 6), and β=0.075 clean 92.61 (both Fig 4 and Fig 5). The baseline clean accuracy thus varies by 2.02 points across the four tables and the RobustDLRT clean value differs from the β=0.075 sweep by exactly +2.0 (94.61 vs 92.61), even though clean accuracy is attack-independent and should match. Some cells in Table 2 appear inflated by a fixed offset relative to the appendix tables.

predicted_errors.error_location: Equation numbering; Remarks 1-2 and Proposition 2 proof
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: Numbered equations run (1), (2), (3), then (5), (6), (7), (8), (9), (10), (11a-c) — no equation (4) exists anywhere in the paper. Yet Remark 1 ('the bound of Equation (4) is not useful'), Remark 2 ('the proper scaling in (4)'), and the Proposition 2 proof closing line ('which, after exponentiation, yields (4)') all reference a non-existent equation (4). This also obscures the Proposition 2 statement/proof mismatch, since the statement's bound is the intended target of these references.

Reference [56] (J. Zhao et al., 'GaLore: Memory-efficient LLM training by gradient low-rank projection') is never cited in the text. The only mention of the method is in Section 3 line 83 ('Memory reductions via gradient projection, e.g., GaLore'), which carries no bracket citation. Among all bibliography entries [1]-[57], [56] is the sole dangling reference.

predicted_errors.error_location: Table 2 Mixup columns vs Figure 6 sweep
predicted_errors.supporting_evidence: Table 2's RobustDLRT Mixup entries (ε=0.045 → 70.12, ε=0.1 → 47.31) equal Figure 6's β=0.15 sweep values at ε=0.1 (70.12) and ε=0.75 (47.31), respectively, and the Mixup ε=0.75 column is empty for every data row of Table 2. The Mixup columns in Table 2 therefore appear shifted/misaligned relative to the appendix sweep (Fig 6), so the same model/attack/ε is reported with different numbers in the two tables.

summary: Uncertainty-mode verification (lenient strictness, threshold 0.30) of paper 10713 segmented 109 snippets and escalated 24 high-uncertainty ones to specialist verifiers (math, statistical, citation, text). Six errors passed the confidence filters. The most serious is a proof/statement mismatch in Proposition 2: the printed condition-number bound exp(R/(2σ_r)) + c disagrees with the proof's derived exp(R/(√2σ_r²)) and is scale-inconsistent (the derivation itself is sound), compounded by a missing equation (4) that Remarks 1-2 and the proof reference. The bibliography contains a duplicated entry ([49]/[50] are the same Xu & Ghamisi paper cited twice) and a dangling entry ([56] GaLore is never cited in the text). The numerical tables contain data-integrity issues: Table 2 clean-accuracy figures (Baseline 94.40, RobustDLRT 94.61 for VGG16/UCM) conflict with the appendix sweeps (92.40/92.61) by a consistent +2.0-point offset, and the Table 2 Mixup columns are misaligned with Figure 6 with the ε=0.75 column missing. Mathematical core claims verified sound: Definition 1/(2)-(3), Proposition 1 gradient, Proposition 3 stability bound and its proof, and the Section 2 sensitivity/condition-number arithmetic (e.g., 2.7785/0.8210 = 3.3844) all check out. Verdict: NEEDS_CORRECTION — the Proposition 2 statement, equation numbering, duplicate/dangling references, and Table 2 values require correction.
